title: Twenty-Two in Alexandria: Riding DMV Transit, Touring the White House & the U.S. Capitol, Meeting Senator James West, The Spark to Run for City Council, & Two Blue Passports
description: Invited up to Alexandria by Dad for a week-long twenty-second birthday trip—taking a taxi van to Newport News Station and riding the ARTS train to ALX—Katie and Nate proudly show Dad their new horizontal 21+ Virginia State ID cards, explore Northern Virginia's buses and trains, unclip their wheelchair backpacks to tour the White House (while President George W. Walker is across the Potomac speaking in Fairfax) and experience Katie's civic awakening in the East Room and State Dining Room, tour the U.S. Capitol Crypt, Rotunda, National Statuary Hall, and Old Senate Chamber, meet newly sworn-in U.S. Senator James West and watch the Senate from the gallery, discover how to run for Virginia Beach City Council after realizing the last bus home from City Hall leaves thirty minutes before 6:00 PM Council meetings even start, and apply for their first U.S. Passports at the Post Office after clerks keep asking 'What's this?' at their State ID cards.
